title: The King of Fighters '99
text:
The King of Fighters '99: Millennium Battle is the sixth game in The King of Fighters series. Introducing new elements like the Striker Match and Counter Mode and increasing the number of characters per team from three to four. The game acts as the first of a three-part story known as the NESTS Chronicles involving a shadowy organization plotting world domination, this part introducing the concept of the Kyo Kusanagi clones and K', who is the main character in this story arc.
